Olivia P: Quick sync — we're lining up a joint marketplace + SI announcement for the gateway + LangChain/LlamaIndex connectors. Need checklist, owner assignments, and embargo windows.

Tara S: @Olivia P noted. Marketing wants 2 weeks lead for co-announce assets. Do we have partner legal signoff timeline?

Sandeep K: Hardware partners (SigmaCompute) need a compatibility badge. Need to confirm quantized model tests on their A100 nodes. Pinged infra.

Mike W: Technical QA: can we confirm SSO flow works with partner SAML and our token exchange? If not, fallback doc needed.

Gabe (SI): SI side — we'll validate connector install in their staging. ETA 3 business days. Will surface any schema drift with LlamaIndex.

PartnerBot: Reminder: marketplace listing draft due in 48h. https://internal/redwood/marketplace-drafts :eyes:

Olivia P: Draft checklist (quick):
```
- Marketplace listing draft (owner: Tara)
- Legal signoff (owner: Legal)
- SSO/SAML smoke (owner: Mike)
- Connector install + e2e (owner: Gabe)
- HW compat tests (owner: Sandeep)
- Co-announcement blog + press kit (owner: Marketing)
- Embargo window set (owner: Olivia)
```

Tara S: I'll take marketplace listing + press kit. Can we get final logos from partners by EOD tomorrow? :calendar:

Mike W: I'll run SSO validation today. If SAML has corner cases, propose fallback oauth exchange snippet:
```
POST /oauth/token
{ "grant_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:saml2-bearer", ... }
```

Sandeep K: Infra: running quantized model on partner cluster now. Will post perf numbers in thread.

Gabe (SI): Noted. Will start connector smoke run and share logs here. If any minor breaking changes, we'll patch and retest.

Olivia P: Good. Let's reconvene in 24h. If anyone hits a blocker, drop SLACK thread or @me. :thumbsup:
